summary: Tested Lead Detail Modal + Notes feature in Admin Dashboard. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (auth, detail fetch with notes[], invalid/nonexistent IDs, note creation with correct author, persistence via GET, recent_leads.lead_id field). Frontend: full Playwright flow passed – login, click Recent Leads row, modal opens with lead info + email status + 3 notes, save new note (shows as 'Admin (Holger)'), close via X, close via overlay click, delete button stopPropagation works.
critical_code_review_comments: AnalyticsDashboard.jsx is 833 lines – consider splitting the LeadDetailModal into its own component for maintainability.
AdminPage.jsx is very large (>2000 lines) – splitting per-tab could improve DX.
openLeadDetail catches errors but does not set an error state visible to admin – if fetch fails, spinner disappears silently. Minor UX issue.
get_lead_detail() swallows generic exceptions as 400 – a truly invalid ObjectId will surface as 400 which is fine, but consider explicit InvalidId handling for a cleaner 400 vs. 500 boundary.

Cookie consent banner (data-testid='cookie-consent-banner') is rendered twice in the DOM – detected as 'strict mode violation: resolved to 2 elements' during Playwright. Not blocking, but should be de-duplicated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, modal open, note save, close via X, close via overlay, delete stopPropagation)

seed_data_creation: Test notes with 'UI_TEST_' and 'TEST_note_' prefixes were added to lead 6a3c02362410b0fd1dd810e0 via test runs; these are non-destructive and can be ignored or cleaned via /api/admin/analytics/reset if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie consent banner blocks clicks – set localStorage key 'euroadria_cookie_consent' with a JSON object before interacting, or remove the banner DOM node. There are TWO cookie-consent-banner elements in the DOM (duplication issue). Known good lead ID: 6a3c02362410b0fd1dd810e0 (John Smith). Backend routes: GET /api/admin/leads/{id}, POST /api/admin/leads/{id}/notes, DELETE /api/admin/leads/{id}. Frontend testids: lead-row-{i}, lead-detail-modal, lead-detail-name, lead-detail-close, lead-note-input, lead-note-save, lead-note-{idx}, delete-lead-{i}.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found. Feature works end-to-end.
